description: This file contains source code for traversing and processing Git objects such as commits, trees, blobs, and tags. It implements a depth-first traversal of the object graph with filtering capabilities, and provides functions to control the traversal process, display objects, and manage object states within a revision traversal context.

classes.name: struct traversal_context
classes.description: Context structure used during traversal to hold traversal state, callback functions, filters, and depth information.

methods.name: void show_commit(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Calls the user-defined show_commit callback for a given commit if it exists.

methods.name: void show_object(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct object * object,const char * name)
methods.description: Calls the user-defined show_object callback for a given object if it exists, considering filter conditions such as pack presence.

methods.name: void process_blob(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct blob * blob,struct strbuf * path,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a blob object, applying filters, marking it as seen, and invoking display callback if appropriate.

methods.name: void process_tree_contents(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base)
methods.description: Iterates over the entries in a tree object, recursively processing subtrees and blobs.

methods.name: void process_tree(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a tree object, including filtering, depth checking, parsing, and recursively traversing its contents.

methods.name: void process_tag(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct tag * tag,const char * name)
methods.description: Processes a tag object, applying filtering and display if needed.

methods.name: void mark_edge_parents_uninteresting(struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge)
methods.description: Marks the parent commits of a given commit as uninteresting and optionally displays edges.

methods.name: void add_edge_parents(struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge,struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Adds parent commits of a given commit to an object set and marks them as uninteresting if necessary.

methods.name: void mark_edges_uninteresting(struct rev_info * revs,show_edge_fn show_edge,int sparse)
methods.description: Marks commit edges as uninteresting based on traversal options, handling sparse and aggressive edge hint modes.

methods.name: void add_pending_tree(struct rev_info * revs,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Adds a tree object to the list of objects to process.

methods.name: void traverse_non_commits(struct traversal_context * ctx,struct strbuf * base)
methods.description: Processes non-commit objects in the pending list, handling tags, trees, and blobs.

methods.name: void do_traverse(struct traversal_context * ctx)
methods.description: Main traversal loop that processes commits and associated objects according to filters and options.

methods.name: void traverse_commit_list_filtered(struct rev_info * revs,show_commit_fn show_commit,show_object_fn show_object,void * show_data,struct oidset * omitted)
methods.description: Entry point to traverse a list of commits with filtering, specifying callbacks for displaying commits and objects.
